Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class MyDealsService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.MyDealsService
public final class MyDealsService extends Object
Manage My Deals (SRS UC-1.6): the buyer answers a seller's counter-offer, returns a borrowed item or marks a purchase or claim complete. Every change goes through DealLifecycle (which saves it) and the other party is notified.

Refusals throw with a message for the buyer: SecurityException if the actor is not the active buyer of that request or deal, IllegalStateException if the action no longer applies (including A2 and A3, which change state before refusing).

  • Method Details

    • acceptCounter

      public Deal acceptCounter(User actor, DealRequest request)
      Accepts the seller's counter: the request becomes Accepted with the countered terms, a deal opens, the listing is Reserved or Lent, and the other open requests on it are declined. If the listing is no longer available the request is declined instead (A2).

    • declineCounter

      public DealRequest declineCounter(User actor, DealRequest request)
      Declines the seller's counter; the request is Declined and the seller is told.

    • returnItem

      public Deal returnItem(User actor, Deal deal)
      Returns a borrowed item: the deal is Returned with today's date, the listing is Live again and the seller is told. If the due date has passed the loan is auto-returned instead (or already was) and the buyer is told so (A3).

    • autoReturn

      public boolean autoReturn(Deal deal)
      Auto-returns an overdue loan (SRS UC-1.6 special requirements): the deal is Auto-Returned, the listing Live again, and both parties are told. A system action with no actor, also used by the due-date timer (#22). Does nothing if the loan is no longer active.
      Returns:
      whether the loan was auto-returned now

    • markComplete

      public Deal markComplete(User actor, Deal deal)
      The buyer confirms receiving a purchased or claimed item: the deal is Completed and the listing Sold or Given, and the seller is told. The screen then prompts for a rating.
